_comment: Default agent models for Claude Code (dashed format). Used by Settings > Agents 'Restore defaults' and the /api/agent-model-preferences endpoints. Edit this file to change defaults for all users. ac-verifier and bug-auditor default to claude-haiku-5-5 for a small change and are raised to claude-sonnet-5-5 per run when scripts/diff-digest.js reports model_tier: claude-sonnet-5-5. Every id here must exist in AGENT_MODEL_ALLOWLIST (server.js) and MODEL_ALLOWLIST (js/settings-agenci.js).
